title: Ukufakwa Kwekhadi Le-SASSA — Ukuphakela Ikhadi Elilahlekile, Elicutshunyelwe, Noma Elonakalile
description: Umhlahlandlela ngezinyathelo zokufaka ikhadi le-SASSA elilahlekile, elicutshunyelwe, noma elonakalile: yini okufanele yenziwe ngokushesha, ukuphi lapho uzoya khona, imibhalo edingekayo, izindleko, nesikhathi sokucubungula.

seo.metaTitle: Ukufakwa Kwekhadi Le-SASSA — Uhlobo Lwekhadi Elilahlekile, Elicutshunyelwe, Noma Elonakalile
seo.metaDescription: Ulahlekelwe noma woniwe ikhadi le-SASSA? Umhlahlandlela ngezinyathelo wokuthola esinye: ukuphi, imibhalo okufanele uyilethe, isikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi ungafinyelela kanjani i-grant yakho ngenkathi ulindile.

contentBlocks.title: Ukufakwa Kwekhadi Le-SASSA — Ukuphakela Ikhadi Elilahlekile, Elicutshunyelwe, Noma Elonakalile
contentBlocks.description: Ulahlekelwe, wacutshunyelwa, noma woniwe ikhadi le-SASSA? Ukuthola elinye kulula. Funda izinyathelo okufanele uzithathe ngokushesha, ukuphi lapho uzoya khona, imibhalo okufanele uyidinge, nokuthi ungafinyelela kanjani i-grant yakho ngenkathi ulindile.

contentBlocks.text: Ukulahlekelwa ikhadi le-SASSA noma ukuthi licutshunyelwa kungaxaka, kodwa ukuthola esinye kulula. Lokhu ikona okufanele ukwenze, ukuphi lapho uzoya khona, nokuthi yimiphi imibhalo okufanele uyidinge.

Ukulahlekelwa ikhadi lakho lokukhokhelwa kungaba njengokulahlekelwa ekuphela kwendlela yakho yokufinyelela i-grant yakho, kodwa imali yakho ayipheli — ihlala iphephile kusistimu ye-SASSA kuze kube yini uyithola. Noma ikhadi lakho lacutshunyelwa, lahleleka ngenxa yokuhamba, noma i-chip yashiya yini, ukufakwa ukubonakalisa ukubona umsebenzi ojwayelekile. Futhi ngenkathi ulindile, kukhona inketho yemali esebenza ngaphandle kwekhadi ngokuphelele.
Uma Ikhadi Lakho Lilahlekile Noma Licutshunyelwe

steps.title: Bika kupholisa (uma licutshunyelwe)
steps.description: Uma ikhadi lakho licutshunyelwe, famba ifomu lepholisa esikhungweni se-SAPS esisedu kunakho konke. Uzodinga inombolo yecala ngenkathi ufaka isicelo sokufakwa.

steps.title: Vakashela isikhungo se-SASSA esisedu kunakho konke
steps.description: Yiya esikhungweni se-SASSA sendawo esisedu kunakho konke nedokhumenti yakho ye-ID. Uma i-ID yakho nayo yacutshunyelwa, thola i-affidavit ku-SAPS.

steps.title: Gcwalisa ifomu lokufakwa
steps.description: Umhloli we-SASSA uzokusiza ngefonu yesicelo sokufakwa kwekhadi. Mema ngokusemthethweni ukuthi ikhadi lakho lahleleka noma lacutshunyelwa.

steps.title: Thola ikhadi lakho elisha
steps.description: Ikhadi lokufakwa ngokuvamile linikezwa kungakapheli amaviki angu-2 kuya kwangu-4. Uzokwaziswa uma selilungele ukuthathwa.

contentBlocks.text: Uma ikhadi le-SASSA lonakalile (likhambiwe, ligugile, noma i-chip ingasasebenzi), vakashela isikhungo se-SASSA esisedu kunakho konke ne-ID yakho nekhadi lonakalile. Ukufakwa ngokuvamile kuyashesha kunamakhadi alahlekile, ngokuvamile kucubungulwa kungakapheli amaviki angu-1 kuya kwangu-2.
Ungafinyelela Kanjani I-Grant Yakho Ngenkathi Ulindile

Ngenkathi ulindele ikhadi lakho lokufakwa, usengafinyelela i-grant yakho. Shintsha indlela yakho yokukhokhelwa ku-Cash Send nge-SRD portal. Uzothola i-voucher ye-SMS ongayisebenzisa ukuthatha i-grant yakho ngemalı kumniningo we-Pick n Pay, Shoprite, Boxer, Checkers, noma Usave.

faqs.question: Ukufakwa kwekhadi le-SASSA kubiza malini?
faqs.answer: Ukufakwa kokuqala kuyamahhala. Ukufaka okulandelayo kungase kubangele imali encane yokuphatha ngokwenqubomgomo ye-SASSA.

faqs.question: Ngiyakwazi ukuthola i-grant yami ngaphandle kwekhadi?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Shintsha ku-Cash Send noma ithunyelwe ebhange ngenkathi ulindele ikhadi lokufakwa.

faqs.question: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ikhadi lokufakwa?
faqs.answer: Amakhadi alahlekile/akutshunyelwa: amaviki angu-2 kuya kwangu-4. Amakhadi onakalile: amaviki angu-1 kuya kwangu-2.
